task: Reconcile and verify competitor PRICING claims across the three 2026-09-08 extracts, the wave2 teardowns, and the founder-pasted Hermes 2026-09-08 run report
fetch_window_utc: 2026-09-08 approx 18:52Z to 19:04Z (date -u read 18:57:51Z and 19:04:26Z during the run)
method: For each domain: corpus claims collected by grep over data/raw/extractdata20260908*.json (pricing_tiers fields), wave2/*.md, _propfinder-teardown-final.md, and the intel-repo main checkout; then the cited public pricing page fetched (WebFetch, plus curl of the served HTML with a browser UA where the summariser saw no prices). robots.txt read for every host before any non-obvious path. No logins, no paywall crossing, no /api probing, no /_next chunk inspection (stokastic.com robots disallows /_next/). Wayback (web.archive.org) is not fetchable by the tool. Stripe price IDs and a promotion-code identifier seen in Unabated's inline JSON were NOT copied.

surfaces_unreachable.oddsjam.com: HTTP 403 on /subscribe (WebFetch and curl), /betting-tools, /betting-tools/arbitrage, /betting-tools/positive-ev; robots.txt allows these paths, so the 403 is a bot block, not a robots rule; not evaded. Only public evidence readable: Apple App Store IAP list id6448072108.
surfaces_unreachable.stokastic.com/pricing: HTTP 200 but Next.js client-rendered RSC payload; served HTML (58,371 bytes) contains zero dollar prices, zero tier names (Core/Max/MVP absent), zero price_-shaped tokens, zero checkout/stripe links. Prices taken from Stokastic's own on-domain articles instead.
surfaces_unreachable.fantasylabs.com/subscribe: HTTP 200, client-rendered; served HTML (32,089 bytes) has no prices. Server-rendered partner pages used instead.
surfaces_unreachable.props.cash: HTTP 200, 3,660-byte SPA shell, no prices; /pricing same. App Store and Google Play listings used instead.
surfaces_unreachable.rotowire.com/subscribe/payment/?plan=fan: HTTP 200, 11,853 bytes, no dollar amounts in served HTML; /subscribe/ redirects to /subscribe/signup/ (no prices). First-party article used instead.
surfaces_unreachable.teamrankings.com/buy/best-deals/: WebFetch 403, curl with browser UA 200; robots allows /buy/ (Crawl-delay 10 respected: two requests).
surfaces_unreachable.web.archive.org: Tool refuses the host; OddsJam Wayback captures cited in wave2 could not be re-read.
